y-m-50-04.title: Kana function yakabatanidzwa iri one-to-one, mafunction ose maviri ari one-to-one here?
y-m-50-04.topic: Zvatinogona kutaura nezve f ne g kana function yakabatanidzwa g∘f iri one-to-one
y-m-50-04.goal: Wana kukosha kwefunction yakabatanidzwa zvakananga kubva patebhura yakapiwa kuedza chirevo chaEunsu, uye utsanangure kuti chikamu chimwe chechirevo chinoputswa sei necounterexample nepo chimwe chichishanda.
y-m-50-04.material:
Pane maseti X={1, 2}, Y={a, b, c}, Z={p, q, r}. Mafunction f: X→Y ne g: Y→Z ndeaya.
f(1)=a, f(2)=b
g(a)=p, g(b)=q, g(c)=p
Function yakabatanidzwa g∘f inopa g(f(x)) kuchikamu x chaX. Function one-to-one ifunction umo zvikamu zviviri zvakasiyana zvechiyero zvinogara zvakapiwa kukosha kwakasiyana.
Chirevo chaEunsu: "Kana g∘f iri function one-to-one, saka zvose f ne g mafunction one-to-one."
y-m-50-04.thinking.0: Paradzanisa chirevo kuita zvikamu zviviri uye utonge chimwe nechimwe wega

Zvinofungidzirwa: wakatoziva tsananguro yefunction, kuwana kukosha kwefunction yakabatanidzwa (g∘f)(x)=g(f(x)), nezvinoreva function one-to-one (zvikamu zviviri zvakasiyana zvechiyero zvinogara zvichienderana nekukosha kwakasiyana). One-to-one correspondence nemainverse functions hazvishandiswi.
y-m-50-04.s.s1.prompt: Wana kukosha kwe g∘f zvakananga kuna f ne g zviri pamusoro, uye usarudze zvinoratidzwa nemuenzaniso uyu nezvechirevo chaEunsu.
y-m-50-04.s.s1.hint.0: Wana g∘f(1) ne g∘f(2) wega uye uzvirongedze mutebhura.
y-m-50-04.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kana kukosha kuri kwose kwatatu g(a), g(b), g(c) kwe g kuchienzana kune mumwe.
y-m-50-04.s.s1.o.a: Kana g∘f iri one-to-one, saka g inofanirawo kuva one-to-one
y-m-50-04.s.s1.r.a: Enzanisa g(a) ne g(c). Ongorora kana g iyi ine nyaya umo zvikamu zviviri zvakasiyana zvine kukosha kwakafanana.
y-m-50-04.s.s1.o.b: Mumuenzaniso uyu, g∘f haisi function one-to-one
y-m-50-04.s.s1.r.b: Verenga g(f(1)) ne g(f(2)) zvakananga uye uongorore kana dzakaenzana. Tarisa kana wakatonga usati waverenga.
y-m-50-04.s.s1.o.c: Kunyange kana g∘f iri one-to-one, g inogona kusava one-to-one
y-m-50-04.s.s1.o.d: c haionekwi pakati pekukosha kwe f, saka hapana chikonzero chekufunga g(c) mumuenzaniso uyu
y-m-50-04.s.s1.r.d: Kuti g iri one-to-one here kunofanira kuongororwa pachikamu chega chega chechiyero Y che g. Ongorora zvakare kuti g inotora kukosha kupi pa c, isingaonekwi pakati pekukosha kwe f.
y-m-50-04.s.s1.explain: g∘f(1)=g(a)=p uye g∘f(2)=g(b)=q, saka g∘f iri one-to-one. Asi g(a)=g(c)=p, saka g haisi one-to-one. Saka chikamu chechirevo chinoti 'g futi' chinoputswa nemuenzaniso mumwe uyu. Counterexample imwe inogona kuputsa 'nguva dzose'.

y-m-50-03.title: Kufambisa wobva wasunungura nekusunungura wobva wafambisa: mugumisiro wakafanana here?
y-m-50-03.topic: Kurongeka kwekutamisa girafu nekuiratidza pa x-axis (mamiriro ekuti migumisiro ifanane)
y-m-50-03.goal: Simbisa necounterexample kuti girafu inobuda inogona kusiyana zvichienderana nekurongeka kwekutamisa nekuratidza pa x-axis, wana iwe amene nyaya umo kuchinja kurongeka kunopa girafu imwe chete, uye utsanangure kuti nei uchishandisa nzvimbo yevertex.
y-m-50-03.material:
Ngachinje girafu ye y=x² nenzira mbiri.
Nzira A: Tanga waratidza pa x-axis, wobva wayitamisa ne p kunzira ye x ne q kunzira ye y.
Nzira B: Tanga wayitamisa ne p kunzira ye x ne q kunzira ye y, wobva waratidza pa x-axis.
(p yakanaka inoreva kufamba kurudyi uye p isina kuruboshwe, uye q yakanaka inoreva kumusoro uye q isina kudzika. Kuratidza pa x-axis kunoreva kuitendeudza kumusoro-pasi.)
Minho anoti, "Kunyange kana ukachinja kurongeka, girafu inobuda inogara yakafanana."

y-m-50-03.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza kukosha kwose kwekuedza (p, q) kunogona kuratidza kuti chirevo chaMinho hachina kururama. (Nyaya umo migumisiro yegirafu yeA neB yakasiyana pakati pavo)

y-m-50-06.topic: Huwandu hwemapoinzi okusangana kwegirafu yebasa irrational y=√(x-1)+2 nemutsetse y=x+k (inochinja sei na k)
y-m-50-06.goal: Yedza nekukosha chaiko pfungwa yokuti huwandu hwemapoinzi okusangana hunochinja zvishoma nezvishoma apo mutsetse unofamba munzira imwe, tsvaga kukosha kwakati wandei kunosangana namamiriro, uye utsanangure kuti huwandu hwemapoinzi okusangana hunoenderana nemhando ye k.
y-m-50-06.material:
Girafu yebasa f(x)=√(x-1)+2 (x≥1) ikakona inotanga papoinzi (1, 2) uye inokwira zvishoma nezvishoma kurudyi. (√ inoverengwa 'square root', uye √(x-1) ndi 'square root ye x bvisa 1'.) Mienzaniso yokukosha: f(1)=2, f(2)=3, f(5)=4, f(10)=5.
Tinotamisa mutsetse y=x+k (slope 1, k inhamba yakagadzikana) kumusoro nepasi. Seohyun anoti, "Kana k ichikura, mutsetse unokwira, saka huwandu hwemapoinzi anosangana negirafu huchaenderera kukura."
y-m-50-06.prereq.0: 'H1' mubasa iri inongova mazwi okuoma mukugoverwa kwokugadzirwa uye haireve kuti kurikulamu inodzidzisa zvirimo izvi kugiredhi rakati. Pfungwa yokutanga: fungidzira kuti wakatoziva kuti girafu yebasa irrational y=√(x-p)+q inotanga papoinzi (p, q) uye inokotama kumusoro kurudyi, kuti mukati mesquare root munofanira kuva 0 kana kupfuura, huwandu hwemidzi yechirevo che quadratic nediscriminant, nokuona mapoinzi okusangana kwemagirafu semhinduro dzezvirevo zvakabatanidzwa.
y-m-50-06.s.s1.prompt: Ongorora huwandu hwemapoinzi umo mutsetse y=x+k unosangana negirafu kuna k=0, 1, 2. Sarudza zvaunogona kudzidza pamusoro pemashoko aSeohyun kubva pamhedzisiro.

y-m-50-06.s.s1.hint.1: Patafura, tsvaga pakuenzanisa panochinja pakati penguva apo f(x) yakakura kupfuura mutsetse nenguva apo iri diki.

y-m-50-06.s.s1.r.a: Kuna k=1, verenga f(x) ne x+1 pa x=1 ne x=2 uye uzvienzanise. Verenga kuti x dzingani dzinopa kukosha kwakafanana.
y-m-50-06.s.s1.o.b: Kuna k=0, 1, 2, mapoinzi okusangana ndi 1, 2, 0, saka anowedzera wobva adzikira

y-m-50-06.s.s1.r.c: Kuna k=2, enzanisa kukosha kuti uone kana mutsetse uri pamusoro kana pasi pegirafu pa x=1, 2, 5, 10. Tarisa kana paine poinzi yokusangana.

Kana k=1, saka f(1)=2=1+1 ne f(2)=3=2+1, saka vanosangana pa x=1 ne x=2 (mapoinzi maviri). Kana k=2, mutsetse unogara uri pamusoro pegirafu uye havasangani (mapoinzi 0). y-m-50-02.topic: Kusarudza zviratidzo zvemacoefficients kubva patsananguro yegirafu yequadratic function y=ax²+bx+c (kukwana kweruzivo)
y-m-50-02.goal: Tonga kuti musanganiswa upi pakati peruzivo rwakawanda runotsanangura girafu nemashoko unokwana kusarudza zviratidzo zvemacoefficients, uye ugadzire mafunction akasiyana anoita tsananguro dzose kusimbisa kuti tsananguro dzoga hadzigadzike function kuita imwe.
y-m-50-02.material:
Jimin akatsanangura girafu yequadratic function y=ax²+bx+c (a, b, c nhamba chaiyo, a≠0) nemashoko. Hapana mufananidzo. Mutaurire unoverengwa 'y equals a times x squared plus b times x plus c'.
(가) Girafu inovhura kumusoro (convex pasi).
(나) Y-coordinate yepoinzi umo inosangana ne y-axis i3.
(다) Vertex iri kurudyi kwe y-axis. (X-coordinate yevertex yakanaka.)
(라) Inosangana ne x-axis pamapoinzi maviri akasiyana.
y-m-50-02.thinking.1: Fungidzira hukama pakati penzvimbo yevertex nezviratidzo zvemacoefficients
y-m-50-02.prereq.0: 'H1' mumushando uyu inongova chiratidzo chekuoma mubasa rekugadzira uye haireve kuti curriculum inodzidzisa zvinhu izvi kugiredhi rakati. Zvinofungidzirwa: wakatoziva kuti girafu yequadratic function y=ax²+bx+c iparabola, kuti chiratidzo che a chinosarudza nzira yekuvhura, kuti x-coordinate yevertex i -b/(2a) (kana maitiro ekuishandura kuita chimiro y=a(x-p)²+q), nehukama pakati penhamba yemapoinzi anosangana ne x-axis nechiratidzo chediscriminant b²-4ac.
y-m-50-02.s.s1.prompt: Tinoda kusarudza chiratidzo che b (chakanaka kana chisina). Tsananguro ipi pakati pe (가) kusvika (라) yatinofanira kuziva pamwe chete kuisarudza neruzivo rushoma zvikuru?
y-m-50-02.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga wanyora mutaurire we x-coordinate yevertex uchishandisa a ne b.
y-m-50-02.s.s1.hint.1: Rondedzera misanganiswa yose yezviratidzo ze (a, b) inoita kuti mutaurire uyu ukanake.
y-m-50-02.s.s1.r.b: Vertex kuva kurudyi kunoreva kuti -b/(2a) yakanaka, izvo zvinongoratidza kuti a ne b zvine zviratidzo zvakapesana. Shanda kuti b i chii kana a yakanaka uye kana a isina.
y-m-50-02.s.s1.r.c: (나) ne (라) zvinotaura nezvekukosha kwe c nediscriminant, saka hazvitiudzi chiratidzo che a. Edza kana y=-x²+2x+3 ine a isina (c=3, discriminant 16, x-coordinate yevertex 1) ichiita tsananguro dzose idzi nhatu.
y-m-50-02.s.s1.r.d: (가) inoudza chiratidzo che a uye (나) inoudza kukosha kwe c. Pasina nzvimbo yekuruboshwe-kurudyi yevertex, chinja b ne a ne c imwe chete uone kana chiratidzo che b chakagadzikwa.
y-m-50-02.s.s1.explain: Kana x-coordinate yevertex -b/(2a) yakanaka (다) uye a yakanaka (가), saka b isina. Ne (다) yoga, tinongoziva kuti a ne b zvine zviratidzo zvakapesana. (나) ne (라) hazvibatani zvakananga nechiratidzo che b.
y-m-50-02.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mafunction matatu equadratic ane b dzakasiyana anoita (가) kusvika (라) dzose. (Isa kukosha kwe a, b, ne c.)
y-m-50-02.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza c kubva ku (나), uye usarudze zviratidzo za a ne b kubva ku (가) ne (다).

y-m-50-08.title: Mhinduro yaEunji pahuwandu hwekusangana: mutsara upi wakashata?
y-m-50-08.topic: Huwandu hwekusangana kwe graph ye y=|x²-2x-3| nemutsara wakatwasuka y=m (wakaparadzaniswa nerenji re m)
y-m-50-08.goal: Tsvaga mutsara wakashata mumhinduro yakaongorora huwandu hwekusangana kwe graph ye quadratic function ine absolute value nemutsara wakatwasuka nerenji re m, utarise nekuisa makosha zvakananga, uye uigadzirise.
y-m-50-08.material: Iyi mhinduro yaEunji yekutsvaga huwandu hwemapoinzi apo graph ye function f(x)=|x²-2x-3| inosangana nemutsara wakatwasuka y=m (m ndi constant). (|a| inoverengwa 'the absolute value of a'.) Hapana pikicha.
y-m-50-08.prereq.0: 'H1' mubasa iri inongova label yekuoma mukugoverwa kwekugadzira uye haireve kuti curriculum inodzidzisa zvirimo izvi pagiredhi rakati. Fungidzira kuti waziva graph ye quadratic function (vertex, mapoinzi apo inosangana ne x-axis), zvinoreva chiratidzo che absolute value (|a| ndi -a kana a iri negative), kuti graph ye y=|f(x)| ndiyo graph ye y=f(x) ine chikamu chiri pazasi pe x-axis chakapetwa kumusoro, uye nzira yekugadzirisa quadratic equation.
y-m-50-08.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara mumwe wakashata mumhinduro yaEunji. (Nhamba dzemitsara dzinoratidzwa kubva ku1.)
y-m-50-08.s.s1.hint.0: Kune m=4, tarisa kana pane nzvimbo pamatavi ekunze (x>3, x<-1), kwete chikamu chakapetwa, apo y inova 4.
y-m-50-08.s.s1.hint.1: Verenga makosha e f(x) pa x=3 ne x=4 uye utarise kana 4 iri pakati pawo.
y-m-50-08.s.s1.line.0: x²-2x-3=(x-3)(x+1), saka graph ye y=x²-2x-3 inosangana ne x-axis pa x=-1 ne x=3, uye vertex yayo ndi (1, -4).
y-m-50-08.s.s1.line.1: Nekuda kwe absolute value, chikamu chaiva pazasi pe x-axis (-1<x<3) chinopetwa kumusoro pamusoro pe x-axis. Pamusoro pechikamu chakapetwa ndi (1, 4).
y-m-50-08.s.s1.line.2: Kana m=4, vanosangana pamusoro pechikamu chakapetwa chete, (1, 4), saka pane poinzi 1 yekusangana.
y-m-50-08.s.s1.line.3: Kana 0<m<4, inosangana nechikamu chakapetwa pamapoinzi maviri uye ne tavi rimwe nerimwe remaviri ekunze papoinzi imwe, saka pane mapoinzi 4 ekusangana.
y-m-50-08.s.s1.line.4: Kana m>4, haibati chikamu chakapetwa uye inosangana netavi rimwe nerimwe remaviri ekunze papoinzi imwe, saka pane mapoinzi 2 ekusangana.
y-m-50-08.s.s1.line.5: Kana m=0, inosangana pamapoinzi maviri ari pa x-axis, x=-1 ne x=3, saka pane mapoinzi 2 ekusangana.
y-m-50-08.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 3 wakashata. Zvakarurama kuti kune m=4 vanosangana pamusoro pechikamu chakapetwa (1, 4), asi matavi maviri ekunze anopfuurawo napo y=4. Semuenzaniso, kukosha ndi0 pa x=3 uye 5 pa x=4, saka inopfuura y=4 pakati (x=1+2√2). Divi rimwe rakafanana, saka pane 3 dzose. Mitsara 1, 2, 4, 5, ne6 yakarurama.
y-m-50-08.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira makosha matatu akasiyana e m apo pane mapoinzi 4 ekusangana chaizvo. Unogona kunyora ma decimals.
y-m-50-08.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga nekuisa kukosha kuri nyore senge m=1 kana 2 uye uverenge kuti inosangana nemapoinzi mangani pachikamu chakapetwa napamatavi ekunze.
y-m-50-08.s.s2.hint.1: Sezvaunowedzera m, tsvaga kukosha apo huwandu hwemapoinzi ekusangana hunochinja kekutanga.
y-m-50-08.s.s2.ok.c1: Mutsara wakatwasuka uri pamusoro pe x-axis.
y-m-50-08.s.s2.fail.c1: Kana m iri 0 kana pasi, haigoni kuva nemapoinzi mana ekusangana. (Kana m iri negative hapana, uye kana 0 mapoinzi ari pa x-axis.)

y-m-50-08.s.s2.fail.c3: Ndapota chengeta m pakati pe -10 ne10.
y-m-50-08.s.s2.explain: Kana 0<m<4, pane mapoinzi maviri pachikamu chakapetwa uye poinzi imwe patavi rimwe nerimwe remaviri ekunze, saka 4 dzose. Kana m=0 pane 2, kana m=4 pane 3, kana m>4 pane 2, uye kana m<0 pane 0.
y-m-50-08.s.s3.prompt: Nyora nzira yekutarisa nema expressions kuti pane mapoinzi 3 ekusangana kana m=4. (Gadzirisa |x²-2x-3|=4 nekuiparadzanisa kuita nyaya mbiri.)
y-m-50-08.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora nhamba mbiri dzinofanira kuva kukosha kwemukati kuti absolute value ive 4.
y-m-50-08.s.s3.hint.1: Verenga kuti quadratic equation imwe neimwe ine mhinduro dzakawanda sei (ne discriminant kana nekupatsanura).
y-m-50-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakaverenga huwandu hwe x dzakawanikwa munyaya mbiri dzose uye wakadzivedzera here?
y-m-50-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakatsimbisa here kuti imwe nyaya ine mhinduro mbiri uye imwe nyaya ine mhinduro imwe (double root)?

y-m-50-05.title: Ma asymptote maviri nepoinzi imwe: girafu yakagadziriswa here?
y-m-50-05.topic: Ruzivo runodikanwa kugadzirisa girafu yebasa rational y=a+k/(x-p) (ma asymptote nepoinzi yainopfuura)
y-m-50-05.goal: Tonga kuti ma asymptote oga haagadzirisi basa rational kuva rimwe, kuti kuwedzera poinzi yainopfuura kunorigadzirisa, uye kuti nemamiriro akawanda angapikisana; gadzirisa kana chengeta kutonga kwako, uye ugadzirise iwe pachako kuti ndeapi emamiriro anopikisana okuvimba.
y-m-50-05.material: Ruzivo rwegirafu yebasa rational rimwe runouya rumwe panguva imwe. Hapana mufananidzo. Chirevo se 'y yakaenzana 3 pamwe k pamusoro pe (x bvisa 2)' chinoverengwa saizvozvo. Asymptote mutsetse waunosvika padhuze nawo girafu pasina mugumo asi isingambosangani nawo.
y-m-50-05.thinking.1: Tarisa kana mamiriro achipikisana nomumwe nomumwe
y-m-50-05.thinking.2: Enzanisa nokuongorora kuti ndeapi mamiriro okuvimba
y-m-50-05.prereq.0: 'H1' mubasa iri inongova mazwi okuoma mukugoverwa kwokugadzirwa uye haireve kuti kurikulamu inodzidzisa zvirimo izvi kugiredhi rakati. Pfungwa yokutanga: fungidzira kuti wakatoziva kuti girafu yebasa rational y=k/(x-p)+q (k≠0) ine mitsetse miviri x=p ne y=q seasymptote, nenzira yokuisa macoordinate epoinzi muchirevo kuti uenzanise kukosha.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo runoratidzwa rumwe panguva imwe. Nguva dzose, tonga neruzivo rwasvika zvino, uye kana ruzivo rutsva rwauya, sarudza kuchengeta kana kugadzirisa kutonga kwako.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.hint.0: Isa ruzivo rwega rwega muchirevo uye uverenge kuti zvisingazivikanwi zvingani zvasara.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.hint.1: Isa ruzivo rutsva muchirevo chawakawana pamberi uye uverenge zvakananga kana rwuchiwirirana.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.info: Zvose zvinozikanwa pamusoro pegirafu yebasa rational ndezvokuti asymptote yayo yakamira mutsetse x=2 uye asymptote yayo yakarara mutsetse y=3. Basa iri rine chimiro y=3+k/(x-2) (k inhamba yakagadzikana isiri zero).
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Basa rakagadziriswa kuva rimwe neruzivo urwu oga here?
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Kunyange k iri 2, 5, kana -3, ma asymptote akafanana, x=2 ne y=3. Ma asymptote anotaura chete 'furemu' apo girafu iri, uye haatauri k (kuti girafu inokotama zvakadini, iri mumakona api).
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Rakagadziriswa. Ma asymptote maviri akapiwa, saka k yakagadziriswawo
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kunyange k iri 2 kana 5, ma asymptote akafanana, x=2 ne y=3. Tarisa kana unogona kuziva kukosha kwa k nokutarisa ma asymptote chete.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Harina kugadziriswa. Magirafu ane k dzakasiyana ose ane ma asymptote aya
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Basa rational rechimiro ichi rine ma asymptote maviri chaizvo. Chinoshayikwa hachisi huwandu hwema asymptote asi rumwe rudzi rweruzivo runogadzirisa k.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Ruzivo rwakapiwa nyowani: girafu iyi inopfuura papoinzi (0, 1).
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Kuisa x=0, y=1 kunopa 1=3+k/(0-2)=3-k/2, saka k=4. Girafu yakagadziriswa se y=3+4/(x-2), ndiko kuti, y=(3x-2)/(x-2).
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kana uchiisa x=0, y=1 muchirevo, tarisa kuti waisa x=0 muna x-2 pakuverenga. Chiratidzo chimwe chingasanganwa.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kuisa poinzi imwe muchirevo kunogadzira chirevo chimwe che k. Funga kana chirevo ichi chine mhinduro imwe.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.info: Ruzivo rwokuwedzera: girafu iyi inopfuurawo papoinzi (4, 6). Asi kana ukaisa x=4 muna y=3+4/(x-2) yawakawana pamberi, unowana y=5.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Kana ukachengeta asymptote y=3 sezvakaita, hapana girafu inopfuura napamapoinzi ose mbiri. Kana ukasiya asymptote yakarara yakavhurika se y=a, saka a=3.5, k=5 inopa girafu inopfuura napamapoinzi ose mbiri. Kuti ruzivo rupi rwuvimbwe kunofanira kusarudzwa nomuenzaniso weruzivo nokuti rungatariswa here.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Nyorazve k se 6 uye ukanganwe poinzi yapfuura (0, 1)
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Kana k=6, saka y=0 pa x=0, izvo zvinopikisa poinzi (0, 1) yakapiwa pamberi. Funga kana paine chikonzero chokurasa ruzivo rwapfuura.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Sezvo mamiriro (ma asymptote maviri nemapoinzi maviri) asingashande ose panguva imwe, tinofanira kutarisa kuti ndeapi mamiriro akanganisa
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ruzivo pamusoro pe (4, 6) rungange rwakapfuudzwa zvisizvo, saka chengeta k=4 sezvakaita kusvikira rwasimbiswa
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Vimba asymptote yakamira x=2 asi funga kuti asymptote yakarara ingasava y=3, uye uitsvage zvakare
y-m-50-05.s.s1.reflect: Tarisa maitiro okutarisa zvakananga neruzivo rutsva, nguva yega yega ruzivo rwakawedzera, kuti 'kutonga kwapfuura kuchiri kwakarurama'. Simbisawo kuti pakanga pane zvikonzero zvakati wandei zvinogoneka apo ruzivo rwakapikisana.
y-m-50-05.s.s2.prompt: Ngatitsvageiwo basa rational y=a+k/(x-2) rinopfuura napapoinzi (0, 1) napoinzi (4, 6) uye rine asymptote yakamira x=2. Panguva ino, usagadzirisa asymptote yakarara se y=3 uye utore a sechisingazivikanwi zvakare. Isa (a, k) inogoneka.
y-m-50-05.s.s2.hint.0: Isa (0, 1) kunyora hukama pakati pa a ne k, uye uise (4, 6) kunyora humwe hukama.
y-m-50-05.s.s2.hint.1: Funga kuti (a, k) ingani dzinosangana nehukama hwose mbiri pamwe chete.
y-m-50-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Kana k=0, haribasa rational. Ndapota shandisa nhamba isiri zero.
y-m-50-05.s.s2.fail.c2: y haiite 1 kana x=0. Isa (0, 1) muchirevo kuti utarise.
y-m-50-05.s.s2.fail.c3: y haiite 6 kana x=4. Isa (4, 6) muchirevo kuti utarise.
y-m-50-05.s.s2.explain: Kuisa mapoinzi maviri kunopa a-k/2=1 ne a+k/2=6; kuwedzera kunopa 2a=7, a=3.5, uye kubvisa kunopa k=5. y=3.5+5/(x-2), ine asymptote yakarara y=3.5, inopfuura napamapoinzi ose mbiri. Nemamiriro aya pane mhinduro imwe chete.

y-m-50-07.title: Kana rukova rwuchirebesa, ruchi ruchigara ruchikura here?
y-m-50-07.topic: Kudzikiswa kwedomain mudambudziko rakawanda zvikuru rebasa quadratic (kana vertex iri mukati kana kunze kwemuzinga)
y-m-50-07.goal: Tonga, zvichienderana namamiriro e domain, kana chakawanda zvikuru chebasa quadratic chinoitika pavertex kana pamugumo wemuzinga, gadzirisa kana chengeta kutonga kwako kana mamiriro achichinja, uye ugadzire iwe pachako tafura yechakawanda zvikuru pamamiriro ega ega.
y-m-50-07.material: Tinovaka mbiru yakareba nokushandisa fenzi yose ye 20 m. Divi rimwe rakabatanidzwa kurukova rwakananga, uye hakuna fenzi inoshandiswa padivi iroro. Kana kureba kwedivi rakabatanidzwa kurukova (divi rinofanana norukova) kuri x m uye kureba kwedivi rakananga kwariri kuri y m, saka x+2y=20, uye nzvimbo A=xy (㎡, mamita akaitwa sikweya) ndi A=x(20-x)/2. (x nguva '20 bvisa x', yakaparadzanwa ne 2) x yakakura kupfuura 0 uye idiki kupfuura 20. Kureba x kwedivi rakabatanidzwa kurukova hakugoni kupfuura kureba kworukova.

y-m-50-07.thinking.2: Rongedza mhedzisiro pamamiriro ega ega patafura
y-m-50-07.prereq.0: 'H1' mubasa iri inongova mazwi okuoma mukugoverwa kwokugadzirwa uye haireve kuti kurikulamu inodzidzisa zvirimo izvi kugiredhi rakati. Pfungwa yokutanga: fungidzira kuti wakatoziva vertex yebasa quadratic nokutsvaga chakawanda zvikuru pamuzinga wakadzikiswa (unotongwa kubva pachimiro chegirafu), uye kugadzira chirevo nokuita kureba kwemativi kuve mavara.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.prompt: Nguva yega yega ruzivo rwokureba kworukova rwunochinja, tonga x inoita kuti mbiru ive huru zvikuru, uye kana ruzivo rutsva rwauya, sarudza kuchengeta kana kugadzirisa kutonga kwako.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.hint.0: Gadzira tafura diki yekukosha kwa x ne A uye utsvage kwakakura zvikuru kuri.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kana x inopa kukosha kukuru zvikuru patafura iri mukati memuzinga unobvumirwa we x.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.0.info: Rukova rwakareba zvikuru, saka hapana muganho pa x. (0<x<20)

y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.0.after: A(5)=37.5, A(10)=50, A(15)=37.5. Girafu ya A=x(20-x)/2 iparabola inovhura pasi ine pamusoro pa x=10, saka pa x=10 chakawanda zvikuru ndi 50㎡.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.0.r.a: A(5)=5×15/2=37.5. Verenga kukosha kumwe kuti uenzanise zvinoitika kunzvimbo kana x ikawedzerwa kupfuura 5.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.0.r.c: A(15)=15×5/2=37.5. Verenga uye uenzanise kana ichidiki kupfuura pa 10.

y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.1.after: Muzinga unobvumirwa ndi 0<x≤8, uye pamusoro x=10 iri kunze kwemuzinga. Mukati memuzinga, A inokura apo x ichikura, saka chakawanda zvikuru chiri pamugumo x=8, apo A=8×12/2=48 (㎡).
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.1.r.b: x=10 ndi 2 m refu kupfuura rukova, saka haigoni kubatanidzwa kurukova. Tarisa kuti A inochinja sei mukati memuzinga unobvumirwa we x.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Mumuzinga umo x iri 8 kana shoma, verenga kana A ichikura kana kudzikira kubva pa x=5 kusvika pa 8.
